Actor.description:
Who wrote a record or acted: the session, the program, the person and
the agent's name, each when known, and at least one. Every record type that names who
acted holds one.

agent.description:
The name the agent was given, such as `nightly scheduler`, as
free text.

person.description: The person who acted, such as `luke`, or their email address.

program.description: The program that acted, such as `claude-code` or `codex`.

description:
`plans/decision/v1`: a decision a session made, and why.

Only a stub a hook wrote, which names itself in `written_by`, may leave
`why` empty, for the agent to fill in.

refs.description: Entries in the board the decision concerns, such as an answer.

review.description:
`wanted` when the owner should look at the decision; absent when no
review is wanted.

urls.description: Web pages the decision concerns, such as a pull request.

written_by.description:
The plugin and hook that wrote this stub without an agent, such as
`runs/pr-create`; absent when an agent or a person wrote it.

title: DecisionRecord
